title: Bank Lending and the Transmission of Monetary Policy: Evidence from Loan-Level Data
abstract: We trace how changes in the policy rate pass through to the rates commercial banks charge on new loans, using 4.2 million loan contracts.
gold_sense: money paid regularly at a particular rate for the use of money lent
rationale: 讲贷款定价与政策利率传导，interest 只能是利息。

title: Capital Accumulation and Productivity Growth in Manufacturing Firms
abstract: Using census data on plants, we estimate how investment in machinery and structures raises output per worker.
gold_sense: wealth in the form of money or other assets owned by a person or organization
gold_anchor: wealth in the form of money
rationale: 投资与产出语境，capital 是资本，不是首都或大写字母。

title: Markups, Market Power, and the Pass-Through of Input Costs
abstract: We estimate firm-level price-cost margins for U.S. retailers and show that margins widened as concentration rose, while the share of cost shocks passed to consumers fell.
gold_sense: a profit margin
rationale: 经济学里「边际」「差额」「胜负差」都说得通；这里与 markup、price-cost 并列，是利润率。

title: Social Ties and Informal Lending in Rural Credit Markets
abstract: In 140 villages, borrowers with stronger kinship and friendship ties to lenders repay more often; we argue social bonds substitute for collateral.
gold_sense: a relationship between people or groups based on shared feelings, interests, or experiences
rationale: 借贷语境会诱导「债券」，但这里是 social bonds，指人际纽带。

title: Authoritarian Regime Durability and Elite Coalitions
abstract: We show that dictatorships that institutionalize power-sharing among elites survive longer than personalist ones.
gold_sense: a government, especially an authoritarian one
rationale: 威权政治，regime 是政权。

title: Electoral Volatility and the Collapse of Mainstream Parties in Europe
abstract: Across 22 democracies, we document how vote shares of established center-left and center-right parties fell after 2008.
gold_sense: a formally constituted political group, typically operating on a national basis, that contests elections
rationale: 选举与得票率，party 是政党。

title: State Capacity and the Expansion of the Income Tax
abstract: We measure fiscal capacity across 50 countries from 1900 to 2000 and show how the ability to tax incomes depended on bureaucratic reach.
gold_sense: a nation or territory considered as an organized political community under one government
gold_anchor: nation or territory considered as an organized
rationale: 「状态」「州」「国家」都可能；state capacity 指国家（政治共同体）的能力。

title: Credible Commitment and the Duration of Peace Agreements
abstract: We code 196 negotiated settlements and find that agreements in which third parties guarantee disarmament last longer.
gold_sense: a person or people forming one side in an agreement or dispute
gold_anchor: person or people forming one side
rationale: 政治学期刊会把人引向「政党」；这里是和平协议的「当事方」。

title: Property Rights, Land Tenure, and Investment in Rural China
abstract: We examine how insecure use rights over farmland affect households' willingness to invest, exploiting staggered certification reforms.
gold_sense: a legal concern, title, or right in property
rationale: 产权法里「利息」（抵押贷款）也说得通；这里讲土地使用权，是法律上的权益。

title: The Doctrine of Consideration and the Enforcement of Gratuitous Promises
abstract: Courts refuse to enforce promises unsupported by a bargained-for exchange; we examine how this rule shapes charitable pledges and option contracts.
gold_sense: (in a contractual agreement) anything given or promised or forborne by one party in exchange for the promise or undertaking of another
rationale: 「审慎考虑」在法学文章里同样常见；这里是合同法上的「对价」。

title: Formal Land Titling and Credit Access: Evidence from Urban Slums
abstract: A titling program granted ownership documents to 300,000 squatters; titled households used their land as collateral more often.
gold_sense: a right or claim to the ownership of property or to a rank or throne
gold_anchor: right or claim to the ownership
rationale: 论文语境下「标题」「头衔」都说得通；这里是土地所有权。

title: Amicus Briefs and Agenda Setting at the U.S. Supreme Court
abstract: We analyze 9,000 amicus briefs filed between 1990 and 2015 and show that briefs from the Solicitor General predict certiorari grants.
gold_sense: a summary of the facts and legal points supporting one side of a case, for presentation to a court
rationale: 法院与 amicus，brief 是诉状 / 法律意见书。

title: Lock-Free Data Structures for Many-Core Processors
abstract: We present a concurrent hash table that scales to 256 hardware threads without locks.
gold_sense: a programming structure or process formed by linking a number of separate elements or subroutines
rationale: 并发编程语境，thread 是线程。

title: Adaptive Replacement Policies for Last-Level CPU Caches
abstract: We propose a replacement policy that reduces miss rates in shared last-level caches by 18 percent on SPEC workloads.
gold_sense: an auxiliary memory from which high-speed retrieval is possible
rationale: CPU 缓存，不是藏匿物资的地方。

title: Reducing Scheduling Latency in the Linux Kernel
abstract: We redesign the run-queue locking in the Linux kernel and cut tail scheduling latency for interactive tasks by half.
gold_sense: the most basic level or core of an operating system of a computer
rationale: Linux 调度，kernel 是操作系统内核。

title: Password Memorability and the Usability of Authentication Policies
abstract: In a 600-person study, users asked to create longer passphrases recalled them as reliably after two weeks as shorter complex passwords.
journal: ACM CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
gold_sense: the faculty by which the mind stores and remembers information
gold_anchor: faculty by which the mind stores
rationale: 计算机会议会诱导「内存」；这里讲用户记住密码，是人的记忆力。

title: Single-Cell Transcriptomics of the Developing Mouse Cortex
abstract: We profile 120,000 cells from embryonic mouse cortex and identify transcriptional trajectories of neuronal differentiation.
gold_sense: the smallest structural and functional unit of an organism
gold_regex: unit of an organism|structural and functional|basic unit|unit of life|living unit|building block
rationale: 单细胞测序，cell 是细胞。

title: Open Data Practices and Laboratory Culture in Microbiology
abstract: Surveying 1,100 microbiologists, we find that norms set by lab heads, more than journal mandates, predict whether raw sequencing data are shared.
gold_sense: the attitudes and behavior characteristic of a particular social group
rationale: 微生物学期刊会诱导「培养物」；这里讲实验室的风气与规范。

title: Circadian Control of Gene Expression in the Liver
abstract: We show that a third of hepatic transcripts oscillate daily and identify transcription factors that drive rhythmic expression.
gold_sense: the appearance in a phenotype of a characteristic or effect attributed to a particular gene
gold_anchor: Genetics the appearance in a phenotype
rationale: 基因表达。

title: Host Specificity of Avian Malaria Parasites Across an Island Chain
abstract: Sampling 3,000 birds on 12 islands, we find that Plasmodium lineages infect fewer host species where bird diversity is low.
gold_sense: an animal or plant on or in which a parasite or commensal organism lives
gold_anchor: animal or plant on or in which a parasite
rationale: 寄生虫与宿主。

title: Controlling the False Discovery Rate in Large-Scale Multiple Testing
abstract: We propose an adaptive procedure that controls the false discovery rate when testing millions of hypotheses with dependent p-values.
journal: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series B
gold_sense: the extent to which a result deviates from that expected to arise simply from random variation or errors in sampling
gold_anchor: extent to which a result deviates
rationale: 多重检验，significance 是统计显著性。

title: Variance Reduction for Monte Carlo Estimators via Control Variates
abstract: We derive optimal control variates for estimating expectations under Markov chain Monte Carlo and reduce estimator variance by up to 90 percent.
gold_sense: a quantity equal to the square of the standard deviation
rationale: 蒙特卡罗估计量的方差。

title: Survey Sampling Under Nonresponse: A Calibration Approach
abstract: We show how calibration weights correct nonresponse bias in household surveys when the sample underrepresents young renters.
journal: Journal of the American Statistical Association
gold_sense: a small part or quantity intended to show what the whole is like
gold_anchor: small part or quantity intended to show
rationale: 抽样调查的样本。

title: Auditing Hiring Algorithms for Discrimination Against Older Applicants
abstract: Sending 40,000 matched résumés to automated screening tools, we find that applicants over 50 are 30 percent less likely to advance, consistent with prejudice encoded in training data.
journal: Journal of the American Statistical Association
gold_sense: prejudice in favor of or against one thing, person, or group compared with another, usually in a way considered to be unfair
gold_anchor: prejudice in favor of or against
rationale: 统计期刊会诱导「统计偏差」；这里讲对高龄求职者的歧视，是偏见。
